title: Banished
provenance: Reported by sgoger (highball-db#712, 2026-10-26), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal environment, msync, a ucrtbase=n DLL override, rated 5 of 5 after 12 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. CheifBeef (highball-db#1268, 2026-11-16), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 59 minutes: audio drops out when pausing or switching away from the game, with the corefonts and xact recipes.
notes: Reported perfect on the default engine with Apple's DirectX 12 support on an M4 Pro after a short session. Nothing was measured here. An M1 rated it playable over 59 minutes, DXVK by the report, with the audio dropping out when the game is paused or the player switches away (highball-db#1268).
